reference_sql:
WITH day_orders AS (SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE))
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.n_orders IS NULL) AS days_without_orders
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN calendar c
LEFT JOIN day_orders d ON d.store_id = s.store_id AND d.order_date = c.cal_date
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09'
GROUP BY s.store_code

solver.query:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, s.store_code, c.cal_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM stores s
  CROSS JOIN calendar c
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = c.cal_date
  WHERE s.country_code = 'BE'
    AND c.cal_date >= DATE '2025-03-03' AND c.cal_date <= DATE '2025-03-09'
  GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code, c.cal_date
)
SELECT store_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN n_orders = 0 THEN 1 END) AS days_without_orders
FROM grid
GROUP BY store_id, store_code
